name: Jayden Brooks
household: Lives with sibling who pays half the rent
psychographics: Social and outgoing; uses food and drink as the primary way to maintain friendships and professional networks.
current_solutions: Uses Menulog for group orders, subscribes to Netflix and Spotify Premium, and frequently visits local 'brew bars' for flat whites.
frustration: At 2:00 PM last Saturday, tried to order brunch via a popular app for a group of 6; the app capped the order at 4 people, forcing her to split the order into two transactions, which resulted in double delivery fees and cold food.
decision_style: Asks friends for recommendations on WhatsApp; will try a new place if 3 or more friends have posted positive stories about it on Instagram Stories.
voice: Heavy on slang and abbreviations; uses 'sesh', 'brew', and 'arvo' frequently; sentence structure is loose and casual.
